rootCauseOneLine: buildTimelineTurnSummaryDetails drops every turn-scoped row whose turnId differs from the requested turn (filterExactEventRowsForRequestedTurn), so a late item/completed scoped to the next turn is discarded and neither the scoped-identity whole-item closure (#1510) nor any backfill restores it, while the timeline projection merges the same lifecycle by bare call id (#447) — details render the call unfinished (pending, or interrupted on an idle thread) with no output.
proposedFix: In apps/server/src/services/threads/timeline.ts filterExactEventRowsForRequestedTurn, track item ids that the requested turn item/started inside the window and keep another turn's non-backgroundTask item/* rows for those ids, dropping ownership if another turn emits its own item/started for the same id (preserves #1398 id-reuse isolation). Prototype patch (1714/repro/prototype-fix.patch) makes the invariant test (details.rows toEqual inline children) pass and keeps the other 115 apps/server thread tests green. Before shipping: also fetch the completion when it lies beyond sourceSeqEnd (byte-cut turns) and reconcile the exact-bounds match so it does not turn into a missing-match 500; add the invariant test next to #1510's in timeline-in-turn-window.test.ts. Server-only, no protocol bump.
caveats: Did not provoke a real late tool_result from a live provider; the persisted event shape was seeded directly (unit test with in-memory SQLite, and @bb/db insert into the dev instance DB) — that shape is exactly what the claude-code translator emits per code reading. Correction to the issue: on a real idle thread the wrong details row reads 'interrupted' / 'Tool execution interrupted' rather than 'pending' (pending only while thread status is starting/active). The issue's file path for the translator (packages/agent-runtime/src/shared/tool-item-translation.ts) does not exist at base; the equivalent lives in packages/provider-bridge-protocol/src/bridge-kit/tool-item-translation.ts. Bug also present on origin/main a108fa7ef. Worktree left with three untracked test/seed files under apps/server/test/services/threads/ (no source changes).
